# SwiftTerm

Source: https://github.com/migueldeicaza/SwiftTerm

Tag: v1.20.0, commit 5d14406844143538cd8f8851d2d8a67c1fe443e5.

The Sources/SwiftTerm directory is copied from that revision. The local package manifest builds only the macOS library. Unrelated command-line apps, benchmark and documentation dependencies, and the Git build-metadata generator are not included. SwiftTermBuildInfo.swift supplies the pinned upstream identity without running an Xcode build plug-in. The MIT license is included.
